name: National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation - ADIP
description: Assistance for purchase of aids and appliances for persons with disabilities.
benefits: Subsidised assistive devices based on disability and approved aid.

name: Deendayal Disabled Rehabilitation Scheme
description: Support for voluntary organisations running rehabilitation and special education services.
benefits: Community rehabilitation, training and assistive support through registered organisations.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha / Social Security Disability Pension
description: State disability pension schemes commonly administered through Social Welfare departments.
benefits: Monthly disability pension; amount varies by state.

name: UDID Card Scheme
description: Unique disability identity card for identification and access to disability benefits.
benefits: Single disability identity for certificates, schemes and concessional benefits.

name: Ayushman Bharat - PM-JAY
description: Cashless secondary and tertiary hospital cover for eligible vulnerable families.
benefits: Up to Rs. 5 lakh family cover per year at empanelled hospitals.

name: PM-KISAN for Eligible Farming Families
description: Income support for eligible landholding farmer families.
benefits: Rs. 6,000 annual support in instalments for eligible landholding farmers.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
description: Provides guaranteed rural employment and work opportunities to landless and low-income households.
benefits: Up to 100 days of wage employment per household in a financial year.

name: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Scheme
description: Education, medical and accident benefits for registered construction workers.
benefits: Accident insurance, health support, education assistance and pensions.

name: National Pension Scheme for Traders and Self Employed
description: Voluntary pension for eligible low-income self-employed people.
benefits: Government co-contribution pension with monthly pension after 60.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Persons with Disabilities
description: Educational support for students with disabilities studying pre-matric classes.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Persons with Disabilities
description: Scholarship assistance for eligible students with disabilities pursuing post-matric education.
benefits: Tuition and maintenance support subject to NSP rules.

name: Stand-Up India
description: Bank loans to Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe and women entrepreneurs.
benefits: Composite bank loan between Rs. 10 lakh and Rs. 1 crore for a greenfield enterprise.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
description: Support for traditional artisans and craftspeople with training, tools and credit.
benefits: Skill training, digital incentive, tool-kit grant and concessional credit.

name: National Livelihoods for Persons with Disabilities
description: Skill training and livelihood support through disability and employment missions.
benefits: Vocational training, placement support and entrepreneurship guidance.

name: PM Awas Grisha - Eligible Rural/Urban Housing Support
description: Housing assistance for eligible low-income households, including priority disability categories.
benefits: Financial assistance for a pucca house through participating state urban/rural missions.
